_comment: Optional labels for the character picker. Everything here is optional —
a .glb with no entry still shows up, named after its filename.
Only 'brunette.glb' ships with Plasma. The other entries are ready for the
sample characters in the TalkingHead repo, so they get proper names the
'body' is F or M and only picks which built-in pose variants the renderer
uses. The Mixamo clips in ../animations/ are retargeted onto whatever rig
is loaded, so every character can do every move either way.

brunette.glb.label: Brunette
brunette.glb.note: Ready Player Me. Ships with Plasma. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 — non-commercial only.

avatarsdk.glb.label: MetaPerson
avatarsdk.glb.note: Avatar SDK / MetaPerson sample. Non-commercial, and the shirt carries their logo.

vroid.glb.label: VRoid (anime)
vroid.glb.note: VRoid Studio sample. Stylized anime. Permissive licence.

mpfb.glb.label: MakeHuman
mpfb.glb.note: MPFB/MakeHuman sample. CC0 — the only one here that is free for any use, including commercial. 36 MB.
